newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Treasury 10-yr note yield seen at 6.20-21 pct.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Treasury 10-yr note yield seen at 6.20-21 pct.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury's sale of $12.0 billion in 10-year notes on Wednesday was expected to produce a yield 6.20 to 6.21 percent, market participants said.
In when-issued trade at about 1245 EDT/1645 GMT, the 10-year note was bid at 6.1975 percent.
Traders said they expected decent demand, mainly dealer-driven. But the issue needs to come at 6.20 percent or above to garner retail demand, they said.
The bidding deadline for the auction is 1300 EDT/1700 GMT. Results are expected around 1345 EDT/1745 GMT.
